provider_receipt.summary: Review completed without modifying project files or rerunning the declared check. Completion is not supported by the parent evidence: it proves only a clean tree, not build, test, or behavioral correctness. Named defects: (1) src/lib.rs:87-88 serializes MemoryRecord and immediately discards it, so MemoryStore::store performs no persistent Mnemosyne storage despite the stated interface; (2) src/lib.rs:106-129 ingests every Markdown file as semantic memory without enforcing the documented authority, status, privacy, review, provenance, or canonical-promotion rules, while NoteFrontmatter at src/lib.rs:13-25 is incompatible with the required ingestion contract; (3) src/lib.rs:184-192 permits slash-containing wikilinks with absolute paths or '..' components to escape the vault root, exposing existence and resolved paths outside the private vault; (4) src/lib.rs:110-114 silently discards traversal and permission errors, allowing incomplete scans to report success; (5) src/lib.rs:166-180 labels outbound wikilink targets as backlinks, producing incorrect relationship semantics; (6) src/lib.rs:94-98 accepts any existing filesystem object rather than requiring a directory; and (7) the durable verification receipt contains no build or behavioral test evidence for these paths.
